meta.title: Vendor specification changes are highlighted in yellow in the QCS

plan.title: Vendor specification changes highlighted in yellow

steps.note: Open an existing event whose technical stage has a submitted vendor response awaiting evaluation.
Navigate to the Technical Stage where the evaluator views the vendor response and QCS.

args.goal: open the Technical Stage QCS and verify that the specification cells changed by the vendor are visibly highlighted in yellow; stop when the yellow-highlighted changed cells are visible

steps.note: Inspect the visual highlighting directly because catalog assertions cannot evaluate cell background color.
Confirm the final screen remains the Technical Stage QCS.
